'''2026 Tatooine Regionals Paul Coggins LS zero hour''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Paul Coggins]] at [[2026 Regional Championships]] (Tatooine).

== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Paul Coggins]]
* '''Event:''' [[2026 Regional Championships]]
* '''Stage:''' Tatooine
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Zero Hour / Liberation Of Lothal|V19-L-zerohour.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:26Tatooine Coggins LS Zero Hour.txt |Download]]
